title: Similar: Message Canonicalizer Translation
goal: Translate a Python message canonicalization module into idiomatic Scala 2.13, preserving behavior while redesigning the API around case classes, sealed hierarchies, Option-based absence handling, and collection-driven batch transforms instead of Python-style mutation and duck typing.
skillBenefitRationale: This is a close analogue to the source task: the core challenge is turning a utility-style Python module with flexible input handling and chained processors into clean Scala domain models and expression-oriented code, which makes python-scala-idioms the single critical shipped skill.
